title: Add Slack List items with AI, with the right fields
h1: put a new row in the slack list you chose
description: Turn a specific request into a Slack List row with a bot. Give the list link and say what goes in each column, or create a subtask under an existing item.
keyword: slack add list item with ai
answer: a bot can add a row to a slack list and set its starting cell values. it can also copy an existing row or add a subtask under one you name. this changes the list without an automatic sending prompt, so define the destination and ask for a field preview when you want to review the entry first.
og_line: one request, placed in its list.
what:
list rows are separate from channel messages. paste the list's link and say what goes in which column. the bot fills in a new row to match.

for a subtask, point it at the row it belongs under. for a copy, name the row to duplicate and any values to change. text values can be wrapped into slack's rich-text format for you.
uses: add a facilities request to the team's repairs list with the location you gave
create a smaller packing task under an existing event-preparation row
copy a recurring setup checklist row and replace its title for a new session

routine.message: every weekday at 15:25, take only the facilities requests i marked "ready for list" in this chat today for alderwick hall. use the repairs list i linked here, and show the proposed rows before adding them. after i approve, create each row and tell me here which rows were added. never invent an owner, copy yesterday's entries or post a channel message.
routine.needs: slack connected, with read and write access, and a slack account that can edit the list
routine.output:
alderwick hall list preview
request: replace meeting room door sign
location: west corridor
owner: left unset
awaiting approval to create the row.

steps: under **Connected apps**, connect the slack user account that can edit the destination list and allow **read and write**.
paste the list link and say what goes in each column, then ask the bot to describe one proposed row without creating it.
give a precise rule for missing fields and say that adding a row must wait for your approval.
approve one test entry and open the list to check its cells before scheduling the intake job.
watch: the slack account you connect has to be able to edit that list.
each value has to fit its column, like a date in a date column. the bot should show you the row before adding it.
a duplicate request can become a duplicate row; the example limits intake to entries explicitly marked ready today.

faq.q: can it add a subtask instead of a top-level row?
faq.a: yes. tell the bot which row it belongs under.

faq.q: does adding a list row count as sending a slack message?
faq.a: no. dusk bot treats it as a write. it needs write permission and follows your explicit review instruction rather than the sending setting.
